Interior design, furniture and material supply services

Interior design, product supply, custom cabinets and project-based execution. Choose one service, or hand us the whole project.

Our services

Design

Plan the space before anything gets built.

  • Interior design & space planning
  • 3D interior visualisation
  • Living, dining, bedroom & foyer interiors
  • Material & colour selection

Build

Custom cabinets and furniture, made to your measurements.

  • Modular kitchen design & execution
  • Wardrobes & bedroom cabinets
  • TV cabinets, wall cabinets & custom storage
  • Custom furniture design & manufacturing

Supply

The finishing materials, supplied and pasted.

  • HPL, acrylic & laminate sheet supply
  • HPL / acrylic board pasting service
  • Decorative wall panels & louvers
  • Aluminium profile handles & glass profile frames

Execute

One coordinated team from sourcing to handover.

  • Project-based material sourcing
  • Installation & interior execution
  • Stage-by-stage quality checks
  • Final inspection & handover walkthrough
